title: How to build your first AI agent in 10 minutes

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if I told you you could build an AI agent in 10 minutes?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI agents are changing how we work — and they’re here to stay.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: An AI agent is a program that can do tasks automatically, like booking meetings.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: With tools like Microsoft’s Power Automate, you can build one without coding.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects millions of workers who waste hours on repetitive tasks daily.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI agents are powerful — and easy to use.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see how? Hit follow and I’ll show you step by step.

caption_text: How to build your first AI agent in 10 minutes
